name: navbar-floating
title: Navbar Floating
description: A rounded pill nav that floats inset from the top with a blurred backdrop and a call to action, easing in on mount.

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo or wordmark at the start of the pill.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: Links in the middle. The current one gets aria-current.

props.name: action
props.description: Call to action at the end of the pill.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the pill takes to settle in.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
